name: Zubaida's
short_bio: Zubaida's is one of Pakistan's premier baby, kids, and maternity retail destinations offering newborn essentials, children's clothing, footwear, toys, and nursery gear.
about: Zubaida's specializes in newborn essentials, baby care, children's clothing, shoes, toys, and strollers across Pakistan. BeeDND tracks Zubaida's seasonal sales, 10% to 50% off discount brackets, and official store promos.
